title: 第23章 幻神教会主教第24章 抓获
slug: 兼职管理女子监狱的异端审判官
content_zh:
然而没迈出去两步，狄曼列就转身看了一眼这处已经空空的废弃房屋，轻声开口：“有话再不说我就走了”
随着狄曼列开口，低沉的女声从屋子内响起：“呵呵，不愧是当过高级审判官的人，够敏锐”
很快，屋外就开始浮现了一道被斗篷笼罩的身影，尽管被布料遮住，但还是能看出身材很好
狄曼列看得出这只是魔力影像，所以也没有动手，只是就这么盯着这个女人：“你是主教？还是那个【先知】”
“小女子幻神教会主教娅莫，很荣幸有机会和大名鼎鼎的狄曼列典狱长见面”，自称娅莫的女人微微弯腰，声音有些按捺不住的欣赏
“见面？”，狄曼列语气平静的开口：“我们一般不把视频通话叫见面”
瞬间，娅莫都懵了一下：“事，事平.......通话？”
“别在意，你要是继续废话我就走了”，狄曼列耸了耸肩
“狄曼列典狱长，您都已经被异端审判局驱逐到这里来了，为什么还要替他们卖命呢”
狄曼列没有说话，只是就这么看着娅莫
而娅莫自然也没有在意，继续张开了双手：“您曾是一个强大的异端审判官，完全没有必要蜗居在这个小地方，您甘心就这样结束自己的人生吗？”
娅莫没有等狄曼列回答就自顾自的说道：“您只是受了伤，而我们万能的主可以治好您的伤，甚至让你获得更强的力量，您完全可以.......”
“噗嗤——————”
狄曼列突然忍不住笑了出来，原本平静冷漠的表情也是一副憋笑的样子
见到这一幕，娅莫有些茫然，不确定自己该不该继续说下去
而狄曼列只是憋笑着摆了摆手：“啊，抱歉抱歉，没忍住哈哈哈哈”
“您是在笑什么？是质疑我们的主吗？”
“没有没有，我只是在笑有人打算治我的伤，还觉得能治好”
似乎是笑够了，狄曼列和善的露出了一个笑容：“那么，娅莫女士，你希望我做什么呢？把那条元素精灵龙交给你？还是帮你把水晶城的人献祭一半给你？”
“您不用费心”，娅莫微微欠身：“如果您对那条元素精灵龙有兴趣，您随意就好。元素精灵龙很强大也很特殊，但并非不可替代。水晶城也是，我们有其他方案”

“哦？那我什么都不用做？”
“是的，您只需要当什么都不知道，我相信您也没有上报异端审判局，不然应该已经有异端审判官来了”
“然后我就能得到你说的这些？”
“是的，等到吾主降临，就算异端审判局发现也没有意义了”
“呵”
狄曼列再次没忍住笑出了声：“真是给我整笑了，各方面的”
娅莫明显也看出了狄曼列的想法：“看来狄曼列典狱长并不打算合作”
狄曼列再次露出了一个微笑：“不然呢，你们这帮下水道里的臭老鼠”
娅莫没有什么太大的反应，只是再次躬身：“那么，希望您不要后悔”
话音落下，娅莫这个魔力影像也开始消散，最后这片地上也归于沉寂
狄曼列的表情恢复成了原来平静的样子，迈开步伐
倏地，他手中的手杖猛然反转，直接刺向了后方
“啊呜——————”
锋刃穿透血肉，一只袭来的狼形魔兽瞬间被贯穿咽喉，无力的软了下去
狄曼列没有停留，仿佛随手折断一根树枝般随意，只是轻声呢喃：
“本来还打算费点力，结果自己送上门来了”

阴翳的声音从这座地下室响起，一张圆桌尽头的人影也伸出手指敲了敲桌子

However, before taking two steps, Dimanlie turned around, glanced at the empty abandoned house, and said softly: "I'll leave if you don't say anything else."
As Diamanlie spoke, a deep female voice sounded from inside the room: "Haha, he is indeed a person who has been a senior judge, he is quite perceptive."
Soon, a figure shrouded in a cloak began to appear outside the house. Although it was covered by the cloth, it could still be seen that he had a good figure.
Diamanlie could tell that this was just a magical image, so he didn't do anything. He just stared at the woman: "Are you the bishop? Or the [Prophet]"
"The little girl Yamo, the Bishop of the Church of Illusions, is honored to have the opportunity to meet the famous Warden Diamanlie." The woman who called herself Yamo bent down slightly and her voice could not be suppressed with appreciation.
"Meet?" Dimanlie said calmly: "We usually don't call video calls a meeting."
For a moment, Yamo was stunned for a moment: "Things, everything is fine... call?"
"Don't worry, if you continue to talk nonsense, I will leave." Diamanlie shrugged.
"Warden Dimanlie, you have been expelled here by the Inquisition, why are you still working for them?"
Diamanlie didn't say anything, just looked at Yamo like this
Naturally, Yamo didn't care and continued to open his hands: "You were once a powerful heresy judge. There is no need to live in this small place. Are you willing to end your life like this?"
Yamo said to himself without waiting for Diamanlie's answer: "You are just injured, and our almighty Lord can heal your injuries and even give you stronger strength. You can definitely..."
“Pfft——————”
Dimanlie suddenly couldn't help laughing, and his originally calm and indifferent expression also looked like he was suppressing a smile.
Seeing this scene, Yamo was a little confused, not sure whether he should continue talking.
Diamanlie just suppressed a smile and waved his hand: "Ah, sorry, sorry, I couldn't help it, hahahaha."
"What are you laughing at? Are you questioning our Lord?"
"No, no, I was just laughing that someone was trying to cure my injury and thought it could be cured."
Seemingly having laughed enough, Diamanlie smiled kindly: "So, Ms. Yamo, what do you want me to do? Give you the elemental elf dragon? Or help you sacrifice half of the people in Crystal City to you?"
"You don't have to worry," Yamo bowed slightly: "If you are interested in that elemental elf dragon, feel free to do whatever you want. The elemental elf dragon is very powerful and special, but it is not irreplaceable. The same goes for Crystal City, we have other plans."
"Oh? Then I don't have to do anything?"
"Yes, you just need to pretend that you don't know anything. I believe you have not reported it to the Heretic Inquisition. Otherwise, there should have been an Inquisitor here."
"And I can get what you're talking about?"
"Yes, when my lord comes, there will be no point even if the Inquisition finds out."
"Heh"
Diamanlie couldn't help laughing again: "It really made me laugh, in all aspects."
Yamo also clearly saw Diamanlie's thoughts: "It seems that Warden Diamanlie does not intend to cooperate."
Diamanlie showed a smile again: "Otherwise, you guys are stinky rats in the sewers."
Yamo didn't have any big reaction, just bowed again: "Then, I hope you won't regret it."
As the words fell, the magical image of Yamo also began to dissipate, and finally the land fell silent.
Diamanlie's expression returned to its original calm state, and he took steps forward
Suddenly, the cane in his hand suddenly reversed and stabbed directly to the back.
"Ah wu——————"
The blade penetrated the flesh and blood, and an incoming wolf-shaped monster was instantly penetrated through the throat and went limp.
Diamanlie did not stop, as casually as if breaking a branch, and just whispered softly:
"I originally planned to put in some effort.It ended up being delivered to my door.”
